title: Segurança
description: Eventos do banco de auditoria (E7.1, E7.4): negações, uploads recusados, acessos ao painel, operações críticas, webhooks rejeitados e o estado dos alertas (E7.5).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS "negações" FROM events WHERE name = 'authz.denied' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "recusados" FROM events WHERE name = 'upload.rejected' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "acessos" FROM events WHERE name = 'panel.access' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT count(*) AS "críticas" FROM events WHERE name = 'panel.critical' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at)
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), count(*) AS "negações" FROM events WHERE name = 'authz.denied' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT actor AS "conta", count(*) AS "negações", count(DISTINCT target) AS "alvos distintos", max(occurred_at) AS "última" FROM events WHERE name = 'authz.denied' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY actor ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: Uploads recusados e esperas de cota

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE name IN ('upload.rejected', 'quota.waiting') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Limite de requisições e tokens revogados

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE name IN ('rate.limited', 'token.revoked', 'auth.revoked_token_used', 'user.revoked') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), actor AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE name = 'panel.access' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Acessos ao painel fora do horário (20h às 7h, Brasília)

targets.rawSql: SELECT actor AS "conta", count(*) AS "acessos", min(occurred_at) AS "primeiro", max(occurred_at) AS "último" FROM events WHERE name = 'panel.access' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) AND extract(hour FROM occurred_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo') NOT BETWEEN 7 AND 19 GROUP BY actor ORDER BY 2 DESC

SELECT occurred_at AS "quando", actor AS "conta", action AS "operação", target AS "alvo", result AS "status", reason AS "justificativa" FROM events WHERE name = 'panel.critical' AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT name AS "evento", split_part(reason, ':', 1) AS "motivo", count(*) AS "total", max(occurred_at) AS "último" FROM events WHERE name IN ('payment.rejected', 'shipment.rejected') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(occurred_at, '1h'), name AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE name IN ('address.change_requested', 'address.change_failed', 'address.changed') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT occurred_at AS "quando", name AS "evento", actor AS "autor", action AS "operação", target AS "alvo", result AS "resultado", origin AS "origem" FROM events WHERE result IN ('denied', 'rejected', 'failed') AND $__timeFilter(occurred_at) ORDER BY occurred_at DESC LIMIT 100
